stanzas.sanskrit:
ततो मगधभूभृता चिरनिरोधसङ्क्लेशितं
शताष्टकयुतायुतद्वितयमीश भूमीभृताम् ।
अनाथशरणाय ते कमपि पूरुषं प्राहिणो-
-दयाचत स मागधक्षपणमेव किं भूयसा ॥ ८५-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The Magadha king Jaraasandhan had 20800 kings as captives in his prison. The tormented kings prayed to Krishna & sent a messenger to Bhagwan requesting to free them. Nothing more, but they prayed for killing of the Magadha king.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tato magadhabhūbhṛtā ciranirodhasaṅkleśitaṃ
śatāṣṭakayutāyutadvitayamīśa bhūmībhṛtām |
anāthaśaraṇāya te kamapi pūruṣaṃ prāhiṇo-
-dayācata sa māgadhakṣapaṇameva kiṃ bhūyasā || 85-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
यियासुरभिमागधं तदनु नारदोदीरिता-
-द्युधिष्ठिरमखोद्यमादुभयकार्यपर्याकुलः ।
विरुद्धजयिनोऽध्वरादुभयसिद्धिरित्युद्धवे
शशंसुषि निजैः समं पुरमियेथ यौधिष्ठिरीम् ॥ ८५-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna with his Yadava army intended to start to Magadha when Narada came there and informed about Rajasuya Yagna being done by Yudhistira. Krishna was confused as to which task to take up first. Uddhava pointed out to Krishna that sacrifice demands conquering of enemies, so going to yagna will meet both the purposes. Immediately Krishna left to Indraprastha.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yiyāsurabhimāgadhaṃ tadanu nāradodīritā-
-dyudhiṣṭhiramakhodyamādubhayakāryaparyākulaḥ |
viruddhajayino’dhvarādubhayasiddhirityuddhave
śaśaṃsuṣi nijaiḥ samaṃ puramiyetha yaudhiṣṭhirīm || 85-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अशेषदयितायुते त्वयि समागते धर्मजो
विजित्य सहजैर्महीं भवदपाङ्गसंवर्धितैः ।
श्रियं निरुपमां वहन्नहह भक्तदासायितं
भवन्तमयि मागधे प्रहितवान् सभीमार्जुनम् ॥ ८५-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bhagwan reached Indraprastha along with all HIS wives. With Bhagwan’s grace, Yudhistira and his brothers conquered all the opponents and amassed lot of
wealth. Then Yudhishthira sent Krishna along with Bheema and Arjuna to Jaraasandhan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
aśeṣadayitāyute tvayi samāgate dharmajo
vijitya sahajairmahīṃ bhavadapāṅgasaṃvardhitaiḥ |
śriyaṃ nirupamāṃ vahannahaha bhaktadāsāyitaṃ
bhavantamayi māgadhe prahitavān sabhīmārjunam || 85-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
गिरिव्रजपुरं गतास्तदनु देव यूयं त्रयो
ययाच समरोत्सवं द्विजमिषेण तं मागधम् ।
अपूर्णसुकृतं त्वमुं पवनजेन सङ्ग्रामयन्
निरीक्ष्य सह जिष्णुना त्वमपि राजयुद्ध्वा स्थितः ॥ ८५-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna with Arjuna and Bheema went to Girivraja in the guise of Brahmins and Krishna invited Jaraasandhan to fight with Bheema. Krishna along with Arjuna remained as onlookers.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
girivrajapuraṃ gatāstadanu deva yūyaṃ trayo
yayāca samarotsavaṃ dvijamiṣeṇa taṃ māgadham |
apūrṇasukṛtaṃ tvamuṃ pavanajena saṅgrāmayan
nirīkṣya saha jiṣṇunā tvamapi rājayuddhvā sthitaḥ || 85-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अशान्तसमरोद्धतं विटपपाटनासञ्ज्ञया
निपात्य जरसः सुतं पवनजेन निष्पाटितम् ।
विमुच्य नृपतीन् मुदा समनुगृह्य भक्तिं परां
दिदेशिथ गतस्पृहानपि च धर्मगुप्त्यै भुवः ॥ ८५-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Arrogant Jaraasandhan was fighting ferociously in the battle. Finally Krishna signalled Bheema the way to kill Jaraasandhan by tearing a twig apart and so Bheema ripped him to two pieces and threw the pieces on either side, thus ending his life. The captive kings were then released and Bhagwan happily blessed them with supreme devotion.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
aśāntasamaroddhataṃ viṭapapāṭanāsañjñayā
nipātya jarasaḥ sutaṃ pavanajena niṣpāṭitam |
vimucya nṛpatīn mudā samanugṛhya bhaktiṃ parāṃ
dideśitha gataspṛhānapi ca dharmaguptyai bhuvaḥ || 85-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रचक्रुषि युधिष्ठिरे तदनु राजसूयाध्वरं
प्रसन्नभृतकीभवत् सकलराजकव्याकुलम् ।
त्वमप्ययि जगत्पते द्विजपदावनेजादिकं
चकर्थ किमु कथ्यते नृपवरस्य भाग्योन्नतिः ॥ ८५-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Yudhistira then performed the Rajasooya Yagna during which all the kings were joyfully performing. Krishna who is the Lord of the Universe washed the feet of the holy men and the Brahmins. How fortunate Yudhistira was!
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pracakruṣi yudhiṣṭhire tadanu rājasūyādhvaraṃ
prasannabhṛtakībhavat sakalarājakavyākulam |
tvamapyayi jagatpate dvijapadāvanejādikaṃ
cakartha kimu kathyate nṛpavarasya bhāgyonnatiḥ || 85-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततः सवनकर्मणि प्रवरमग्र्यपूजाविधिं
विचार्य सहदेववागनुगतः स धर्मात्मजः ।
व्यधत्त भवते मुदा सदसि विश्वभूतात्मने
तदा ससुरमानुषं भुवनमेव तृप्तिं दधौ ॥ ८५-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: It was required in the yagna that Yudhistira had to honour and offer puja to the most noteworthy persons among the guests. Sahadeva advised that the worship and honour be offered to Bhagwan Sri Krishna. This gave great satisfaction to everyone, Gods and humans.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tataḥ savanakarmaṇi pravaramagryapūjāvidhiṃ
vicārya sahadevavāganugataḥ sa dharmātmajaḥ |
vyadhatta bhavate mudā sadasi viśvabhūtātmane
tadā sasuramānuṣaṃ bhuvanameva tṛptiṃ dadhau || 85-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततः सपदि चेदिपो मुनिनृपेषु तिष्ठत्स्वहो
सभाजयति को जडः पशुपदुर्दुरूटं वटुम् ।
इति त्वयि स दुर्वचोविततिमुद्वमन्नासना-
-दुदापतदुदायुधः समपतन्नमुं पाण्डवाः ॥ ८५-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Just then, the king of Chedi, Shishupala sprang up from his seat and hurled abuses on Krishna. He called everyone who were honouring and worshipping the cowherd boy, fools. Saying so, he carried weapons and came towards Bhagwan. Pandavas confronted him immediately and prevented him from advancing further.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tataḥ sapadi cedipo muninṛpeṣu tiṣṭhatsvaho
sabhājayati ko jaḍaḥ paśupadurdurūṭaṃ vaṭum |
iti tvayi sa durvacovitatimudvamannāsanā-
-dudāpatadudāyudhaḥ samapatannamuṃ pāṇḍavāḥ || 85-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
निवार्य निजपक्षगानभिमुखस्यविद्वेषिण-
-स्त्वमेव जहृषे शिरो दनुजदारिणा स्वारिणा ।
जनुस्त्रितयलब्धया सततचिन्तया शुद्धधी-
-स्त्वया स परमेकतामधृत योगिनां दुर्लभाम् ॥ ८५-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna stopped his allies, Pandavas to confront Shishupala and cut his head with HIS Sudarshana Chakra. Chedi had gained a purified mind through his three births (as Hiranyakashipu, Raavana and Shishupa),where he was constantly thinking of Bhagwan & thus attained the supreme union with Bhagwan which is not easily attained by the Yogis.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nivārya nijapakṣagānabhimukhasyavidveṣiṇa-
-stvameva jahṛṣe śiro danujadāriṇā svāriṇā |
janustritayalabdhayā satatacintayā śuddhadhī-
-stvayā sa paramekatāmadhṛta yogināṃ durlabhām || 85-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ततः सुमहिते त्वया क्रतुवरे निरूढे जनो
ययौ जयति धर्मजो जयति कृष्ण इत्यालपन् ।
खलः स तु सुयोधनो धुतमनाः सपत्नश्रिया
मयार्पितसभामुखे स्थलजलभ्रमादभ्रमीत् ॥ ८५-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Rajasooya yagna was completed well by the grace of Bhagwan. Everyone praised Yudhishtira and blessed victory to him. Hearing the glory of Pandavas, Duryodhana grew jealous and came to visit them at the palace. He was all the more confused when he mistook the floor for water and water for floor in front of the assembly hall which was built by the Asura's architect Maya.. He walked in and slipped.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tataḥ sumahite tvayā kratuvare nirūḍhe jano
yayau jayati dharmajo jayati kṛṣṇa ityālapan |
khalaḥ sa tu suyodhano dhutamanāḥ sapatnaśriyā
mayārpitasabhāmukhe sthalajalabhramādabhramīt || 85-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तदा हसितमुत्थितं द्रुपदनन्दनाभीमयो-
-रपाङ्गकलया विभो किमपि तावदुज्जृम्भयन् ।
धराभरनिराकृतौ सपदि नाम बीजं वपन्
जनार्दन मरुत्पुरीनिलय पाहि मामामयात् ॥ ८५-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Draupadi and Bheema laughed at Duryodana's ignorance. Krishna planning to reduce the evil people in the earth, made Draupadi and Bheema to laugh more by HIS glances.
Bhattathiri offered worship to Bhagwan who intended to reduce the evil, to protect him from his ailments.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tadā hasitamutthitaṃ drupadanandanābhīmayo-
-rapāṅgakalayā vibho kimapi tāvadujjṛmbhayan |
dharābharanirākṛtau sapadi nāma bījaṃ vapan
janārdana marutpurīnilaya pāhi māmāmayāt || 85-11 ||
